description: When an answer offers a person (lib/agent/handoff.ts handoffActionFor). The button reads Talk to a specialist and opens the operator booking card. It is offered by code only where a person is needed, at most once per conversation; crisis, fraud and hardship name their official channel instead. Scored by lib/agent/handoff.test.ts.

cases.scenario: A plain comparison gets no button
cases.message: Compare the savings account with a 6-month term deposit

cases.scenario: A loan purchase gets no button
cases.message: I want 40,000 lei for a car over 5 years
Can I afford a 2,000 lei monthly payment on 7,500 lei net?

cases.scenario: Asking for a person gets the booking card, not a button
A complaint always offers one, even after an earlier offer
cases.message: Someone took money from my account and nobody helps

cases.scenario: An escalated price review offers one
cases.message: BT offered me 7.2%, can you do better?

cases.scenario: The escalated review isn't offered twice
The first unverified answer offers one
cases.message: What is the Fresh Money deposit rate?

cases.scenario: Fraud gets the official line only
cases.message: Someone from the bank asked for my card code

cases.scenario: Hardship names the support team only
cases.message: I can't pay my loan this month
I don't want to be here anymore
